About GymButler

GymButler is a free, all-in-one gym companion app built to help you train smarter. Whether you're calculating working percentages, converting between kilograms and pounds, or timing your rest intervals, GymButler has you covered.

Features

Weight Percentages

Enter your working weight and instantly see all your training percentages. Customize the minimum, maximum, and step values to match your training program.

Weight Converter

Quickly convert between kilograms and pounds with a simple tap. Includes a handy trick: divide by 2, then subtract 10% for a quick mental conversion.

Timer

Set custom countdown timers with round tracking. Perfect for interval training, with automatic tracking of your best, worst, and average round times.

Stopwatch

Track your rest times with lap functionality. View detailed statistics including average, best, and worst lap times to optimize your training.
